patch_description: This replaces smooth annealed Adam optimization with a two-stage active-set approach. First, a deterministic differential-evolution search optimizes a structured two-ring-plus-poles family that naturally produces strong 14-point packings. Second, the best structured candidates are released into full 42-dimensional space and polished using exact nonsmooth objective evaluations, active closest/farthest contact forces, trust-region line searches, and occasional reproducible escape perturbations. The final selection is always made using the evaluator-equivalent squared distance ratio.
